name: Image library
description: A slideshow, Ken Burns show or photo collage of images from the media library, in one playlist item.

schema.name: source
schema.label: Images

options.label: A connected source (folder, share, Google Drive, OneDrive, ...)

schema.help: "The newest uploads" follows the library: a new image appears on screens without editing this item.

schema.name: media_ids
schema.label: Chosen images
schema.help: At most 200, shown in this order unless Shuffle is on. Images deleted from the library are skipped.

schema.name: image_source
schema.label: Image source
schema.help: Set sources up under Plugins > Image sources. New pictures in the source appear on screens by themselves after its next sync.

schema.name: newest_count
schema.label: How many of the newest images

options.label: Collage (a grid; one tile changes at a time)

schema.name: seconds_per_image
schema.label: Seconds per image
schema.help: In a collage: how often one tile changes.

schema.name: fit
schema.label: Fit
schema.help: This setting replaces the display's fit override for this item. Collage tiles are always filled.

schema.name: background
schema.label: Background
schema.help: Fills the bars beside an image that does not match the screen shape.

schema.name: shuffle
schema.label: Shuffle
schema.help: A new random order each time the item comes on screen.

schema.name: auto_duration
schema.label: Set the item length from the images
schema.help: Number of images × seconds per image (a collage: enough changes to show every image), worked out when you save. Turn this off to use the Default duration above. A playlist's own duration for the item still wins.
